FarReach is original MIT-licensed source. Its bundled network engine statically links the dependencies listed in dependencies.json. Their license and notice texts are included here, along with the Go runtime license. No Tailscale binary or proprietary code is included. TURN packages are transitive WebRTC dependencies; FarReach disables relay configuration and rejects relay paths. Sparkle.framework provides in-app updates; its license and bundled third-party notices are preserved in Sparkle-LICENSE.
